script_summary: Three NAN COMFOR cans emerge sequentially from a branded magenta-purple CGI environment with futuristic molecular overlays. A stylized white bird mascot performs a controlled flight and lands on the hero front-center can. A #1 quality seal badge resolves in the final frames.
clip_strategy: Two self-contained clips: CLIP-A covers opening sequence through product family reveal. CLIP-B covers bird landing, can spread, and badge resolution.

scenes.visual_beat: Magenta-purple gradient background with floating futuristic interface graphics, circular arcs, molecular nodes, fine luminous lines, and drifting particles. Empty product stage.

Stylized white bird with magenta outline rises from behind camera. Large wing passes close to lens creating foreground wipe. Fast creative crash zoom follows bird. Bird flies toward center with controlled wingbeats.
scenes.transition_out: Camera returns to locked hero framing

scenes.visual_beat: Rear-left NAN COMFOR can rises vertically from central luminous glow, eases into rear-left position. Metallic reflections stabilize.
Rear-right NAN COMFOR can emerges from central glow, rises vertically, settles into mirrored rear-right position.

scenes.narrative_function: Hero product entry — front center with luminous pulse
scenes.visual_beat: Front-center NAN COMFOR hero can rises with strong luminous pulse, settles into foreground hero position. This is the strongest visual beat in CLIP-A.
scenes.transition_out: Clip-A ends at hero lock — CLIP-B continues

scenes.narrative_function: Mascot landing — warmth and brand humanity
scenes.visual_beat: Stylized bird performs restrained circular glide above the three cans, gently descends and lands inside the front-center can artwork. Bird remains subtly animated with slight head movement after landing.
scenes.transition_in: Hard cut from CLIP-A end state

scenes.narrative_function: Product spread + claim resolution — final brand statement
scenes.visual_beat: Rear-left can slides slightly farther left. Rear-right slides slightly farther right. Center hero remains stationary. Glowing particles converge in lower-right. Light rays condense into illuminated #1 seal badge — resolves exactly into FRAME-2.
scenes.transition_out: Scene holds on FRAME-2 final state — LED rotation loop start
